messages:
Mia: FYI — OrbitGen is asking for a bundled offer (API + Optimize + Console add-ons). 12mo commit, target ARR $250k. They're pushing for a 20% cross-product discount and onboarding included. Need deal-desk + legal. @Sanjay @Kelly @Eva @Aj
Aj: Quick Q — will they require Private/VPC? that changes infra fees. From the call they sounded like hosted-only.
Mia: Hosted-only. They did flag SOC2 + IP protections in the security questionnaire: https://redwood.share/sec-qs/OrbitGen
Dealbot: Approval request created -> /deal-desk ratecard_exemption RD-4821 :clipboard:
Sanjay: Got it. Need split of list prices, committed ARR, and an estimate of margin impact. Also confirm billing cadence.
Mia: List (annual) breakdown: API $200k, Optimize $60k, Console add-ons $20k = $280k. Customer proposes $250k commit. They want a simple 20% off across the bundle + onboarding at no charge (~$8k value). Billing: annual upfront.
Aj: For POC/workshop — we offered a 2-week trial plus a 2-day onboarding originally. Security: they want logging details and residency guarantees. I'll take the questionnaire and follow up.
Kelly: Finance needs a net price and margin calc. 20% across the board + ~$8k onboarding credit might push margin below hosted tier threshold. Also need to confirm commit refundability and payment terms.
Mia: Commit is 12mo, annual upfront, non-refundable per standard. Customer accepts upfront.
Sanjay: Post the quick calc here so I can log it into the exception form and set an expiry for the approval.
Mia: ```
# list prices
API = 200000
OPT = 60000
CON = 20000
LIST = API + OPT + CON  # 280000
DISC = 0.20
ONBOARD_CREDIT = 8000
NET = LIST*(1-DISC) - ONBOARD_CREDIT  # 280000*0.8 - 8000 = 216000
commit = 250000  # customer target
delta = commit - NET  # 34000
```
Aj: NET comes in at $216k if we give 20% + $8k credit — that's below their stated commit. Options: reduce discount, swap onboarding credit for 1-day onsite workshop (lower cost), or add usage credits billed at delivery.
Eva: From legal — any special commercial concessions require a services addendum (SOW) that explicitly scopes onboarding/workshop. Also need a signed DPA before production access. No extra indemnities or IP handovers.
Sanjay: Given margin impact, I can approve a ratecard exception at 15% off bundle + $5k onboarding credit. Conditions: 1) Signed PO and payment upfront within 10 business days, 2) Mark as 'deal-desk exception RD-4821' in CRM, 3) No additional usage credits. This is a conditional approval.
Kelly: Finance approves subject to Sanjay's conditions and receiving PO + payment. Margin acceptable at 15% + $5k credit.
Mia: Customer prefers 20% but will likely accept 15% if we include a technical workshop. Can we swap the $5k credit for a 1-day workshop? :thinking_face:
Aj: SE can deliver a 1-day workshop (on-site or remote) in place of the $5k credit. We should scope it in the SOW.
Eva: Legal okay with services addendum for a 1-day workshop. Need DPA signed and standard SOW terms. No other redlines.
Dealbot: Ratecard exception RD-4821 updated: APPROVED by Sanjay (DealDesk) 2026-04-02T14:22Z. Conditions recorded. :white_check_mark:
Mia: Thanks all — I'll update the quote to 15% off + 1-day workshop, attach SOW template and DPA, and send for signature. Targeting EOW close. :rocket:
Sanjay: I'll log the approval in the audit tracker and set exception expiry to 10 business days.
Kelly: Ping me when the PO is in and I'll clear finance booking.
Mia: Will do.
